text:
Situation: Carvedilol supply at Corvale General is 283.71 units, providing 19.6 days on hand at 14.5 units per day. The drug is not on the FDA shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) as the registered plant. FDA inspection 590126 ended 2009-06-11 and was classified OAI with a known date of 2009-09-09. A Warning Letter was issued to that plant on 2010-04-08. Subsequent inspections from 2010 through 2026-07-16 were all classified VAI.

Our position: Current inventory is below the 30-day target. The registered plant has a history of OAI classification and a Warning Letter, though recent inspections are VAI. Alternative suppliers are not on the FDA shortage list but their labels do not identify verifiable plants.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to qualify and purchase from NuCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (last inspection NAI 2025-03-12). Requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate A-S Medication Solutions, Advagen Pharma Limited, Advagen Pharma Ltd, and American Health Packaging for plant verification and supply terms. Requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor Bryant Ranch Prepack inspection outcomes and FDA communications. Requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Switching therapeutic alternatives or adjusting clinical protocols without committee review.
